data.text:
DILG REMOVES NCR AND QC FIRE HEADS

DILG Sec. Jonvic Remulla confirmed this in our show Politiko Talks on Bilyonaryo – the NCR head and Quezon City head of the Bureau of Fire Protection were removed after investigation that they were involved in overpriced fire extinguishers.

Ang modus dyan which I attested to DILG Sec. Jonvic during the show is that restaurants or establishments in Tomas Morato who are new or up for renewal are required to get overpriced fire extinguishers from the BFP itself or from a specific supplier.

Kudos to the government for cleaning what Sec. Jonvic Remulla says is “the most corrupt agency” under DILG.

#Accountability
#GoodGovernance

profile_bio.description: I tweet about law, politics, and pop culture. Filipino citizen, lawyer, and LGBT activist.

data.text:
KICKBACK SA BFP? 

Iniimbestigahan ng Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ang dalawang senior official ng Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) dahil sa umano'y kickback sa pagbili ng P30 milyong halaga ng fire extringuishers para sa condominium building.

Sibak na rin ang mga naturang opisyal na nadestino sa BFP Metro Manila at Quezon City District.

Kabilang sa mga nabisto ay ang pagbebenta ng fire extinguisher at panghihingi ng komisyon. | via The Philippine Star
